moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view looking down on hilly farmland with dark trees; the crosshair holds steady at centre.
The picture drops to a flat grey screen; only the crosshair and screen markers remain.
The picture returns blurred, sharpens on the same fields, then the sensor starts sweeping fast over fields, tree lines and compounds.
A tiny white dot is visible upper-left of the crosshair; as the sensor keeps panning, the dot closes in on the crosshair.
The white dot stays close to the crosshair, mostly just left of or below it, while fields, tree lines and buildings stream past.
Black, then white flash; the view zooms in tight on furrowed fields and tree lines. The dot is not visible in this close view.
Another black-grey-white flash, then the wider view returns over fields, canals and a walled compound.
After a flash the sensor zooms far out: a wide patchwork of fields, a town and a winding river.
The view zooms back in on fields and dirt tracks, which the sensor follows to the end.

notes: No black bars; redaction boxes over HUD. The dot is not seen in the zoomed view 2:50-2:55 (official text says it exits bottom left there).
